title: Pick a spot for Sunday
recap: Pipo found a rainy-day spot for Sunday.
funFact: Agents can book things for you, but it's your money. Next, Pipo gets the tickets, and you decide when it pays.
postcard: the family arriving for a fun rainy Sunday out: {answer}
situation: Sunday's free! Want me to find somewhere fun for the family?
facts: 💵 Up to $80 for all of you
🚗 No more than an hour away
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on someone's phone. Help with what they ask. When you suggest a place, your first line names your best pick.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Pick one place for a family day out
pieces.text: Pick one place for a family day out this Sunday, for 2 adults and 2 kids aged 6 and 9.

slots.label: What does Pipo need to know?

pieces.label: It's raining all day
pieces.text: It's going to rain all day.

pieces.label: Up to $80 for all of us
pieces.text: Keep it under $80 for all of us.

pieces.label: No more than an hour away
pieces.text: No more than an hour's drive from home.

pieces.label: Somewhere everyone talks about!
pieces.tip: Popular isn't the same as right for you. Tell Pipo what matters: the weather, the budget, who's coming.

pieces.label: The place, the cost and why
pieces.text: Tell me the place, what it costs and one reason, in a few lines.

pieces.label: Give me lots of options
pieces.tip: Lots of options means more for you to sort through. Asking for one best pick gets you a decision.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo it's going to rain.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know about the rain, so it picked somewhere outdoors.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo your budget.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know your budget, so the cost is missing or too high.

flaws.hint: "Something fun" doesn't say who's going, so Pipo has to guess.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know it's for the family, so it didn't plan for the kids.

lesson: Tell Pipo the things that rule options out: the weather, the budget, who's coming.
